# TODO — retiring the Streamlit dashboard

Working list for bringing the Next.js app in `web/` to full parity with
`streamlit-app-tab.py`, then putting it in production.

Eight of the nine Streamlit tabs are done. The one tab gap below (C) is
**unblocked on data** — every payload it needs is already generated by
`scripts/build_analytics_payloads.py`. E is cross-cutting and can land at
any point.

Ordered by cost-to-value.

---

## C. Projects Attributes — eight distribution charts — closes tab 8

Currently three lists cut at eight rows, which hides the long tail that is
the point of the tab. `project-attributes.json` is 5 KB, so it can stay
server-loaded.

- [ ] Commit activity — active vs dormant (`commit_activity[2]`)
- [ ] Six categorical distributions, each a bar with a top-N control:
      licence, language, code of conduct, contributing guide, ecosystems,
      platform (`fields.*`)

## E. Export on every chart

Only the ecosystem sunburst can be exported today (PNG, SVG, CSV). Streamlit
offers export on one tab and only as HTML, so this overtakes it — but it needs
to be consistent across all nine charts, not one.

- [ ] Lift the toolbar export menu out of `sunburst-toolbar.tsx` into a shared
      component so every chart panel gets the same control
- [ ] Reuse `lib/sunburst/export.ts` for the two remaining sunbursts — it is
      already generic over an `SVGSVGElement`
- [ ] The four bar charts share `HorizontalBarChart`, so one export control
      there covers all of them
- [ ] ECharts charts: PNG via `getDataURL`. **SVG needs `SVGRenderer`
      registered** in `echart.tsx`, which currently registers `CanvasRenderer`
      only, and the instance has to be created with that renderer — so it is a
      per-chart decision, not a flag
- [ ] CSV for every chart from the rows actually on screen, respecting the
      active filters rather than dumping the whole payload
- [ ] Filenames should carry the view: metric, category and top-N, so a
      downloaded file is identifiable later

---

## Country filters — needs a decision before starting

**Projects have no country.** There is no country column in
`data/projects.csv` and no country field in `project-rankings.json` or
`projects-over-time.json`. Only organisations carry `location_country`.

- [x] Organisation views — Organisations by Sub-Category filters on country
      and organisation type, both read straight off
      `organizations-by-subcategory.subcategories[].organizations[]`, matching
      the two multiselects `render_filters` puts on the Streamlit tab
- [ ] Carry the same two filters onto Projects by Organisation and the five
      Organisations charts — the Streamlit tab puts `render_filters` on all
      of them, and only the sub-category sunburst has them so far
- [ ] **Decide:** project views need a country attached per project in
      `scripts/build_analytics_payloads.py`. The join already exists there
      (organisations → projects on a normalised git URL), but that file is
      regenerated by the `update_data` workflow, so changing it is a call
      to make deliberately
- [ ] Use `organizations-overview.countries` (43, ISO-coded), **not**
      `filters.countries` — the latter is built from raw `location_country`
      with no cleaning and contains "Berlin", a city

---

## Production blockers

Independent of feature parity. None of these are about the charts.

- [ ] **There is no deploy path for the Next.js app.** `Dockerfile` is
      `python:3.13-slim` running `streamlit run`, and `deploy-package.yaml`
      ships only that image. `.gitignore` already lists `web/out/`, so a
      static export looks like the original intent — `next.config.ts` has no
      `output` mode set
- [ ] **No CI touches the web app.** Four workflows, none run npm.
      Add a typecheck + build gate; it would have caught the type error the
      old sunburst shipped with
- [ ] **No error boundaries.** `app/` has no `error.tsx` or
      `global-error.tsx`, so any render-time throw replaces the page with
      Next's exception screen
- [ ] **No tests.** No test tooling in the repo at all
- [ ] **Every route shares one title.** Metadata is defined only in
      `layout.tsx`; all four routes present as "OpenSustain Analytics"
- [ ] **Next 15.5.2 advisory.** pnpm flags CVE-2025-66478 on the pinned
      version
- [ ] **`web/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` is tracked** and churns on every
      typecheck; it belongs in `.gitignore`
- [ ] Update `README.md` — it does not mention the web app at all
